sceptic.label: Sceptic
sceptic.note: A new logo rarely moves hard numbers: 95% sure the effect is between −4% and +4%.

open.label: Open mind
open.note: Anything from about −20% to +20% is plausible.

believer.label: Brand agency
believer.note: The brand works: probably between 0% and +10%.

fee.label: 2025 entry, overseas, per year
fee.source: Imperial College London, undergraduate tuition fees 2025-26 (Faculty of Engineering; Faculty of Natural Sciences, same fee). Read 3 Nov 2026.

outcomes.label: Wikipedia page views
outcomes.question: Do more people look Imperial up?
outcomes.note: Monthly English Wikipedia views of each university's article, by people (not bots). The launch month, February 2024, is left out.

outcomes.label: Undergraduate applicants
outcomes.question: Do more students apply?
outcomes.note: Main-scheme undergraduate applicants per UCAS cycle. The 2024 cycle's main deadline (31 Jan 2024) came before the launch, so 2025 is the first cycle after it. 2026 figures are not out until December 2026.
outcomes.source: UCAS end of cycle 2025, provider-level data

outcomes.label: International undergraduate applicants
outcomes.question: Do more students from abroad apply?
outcomes.note: As above, applicants from outside the UK only: the audience a stronger global brand should reach first.
outcomes.source: UCAS end of cycle 2025, provider-level data

breakeven.basis: one year's international intake, at the overseas fee for a four-year degree

outcomes.label: Wellcome grant money
outcomes.question: Does Imperial win more research money?
outcomes.note: Money awarded by Wellcome, the UK's largest charitable research funder, in years running March to February, so the first year after the launch is March 2024 to February 2025.
outcomes.source: Wellcome grants awarded, 1 Oct 2000 to 9 Sep 2026 (360Giving)

breakeven.basis: Imperial's average yearly amount over the last three years before the launch

outcomes.label: Innovate UK projects with industry
outcomes.question: Do more companies team up with Imperial?
outcomes.note: Innovate UK projects (business-led collaborative R&D) that each university joined, by the year of the funding competition (April to March). 2026/27 is still open and left out.
outcomes.source: UKRI, Innovate UK funded projects since 2004 (updated 12 Oct 2026)

breakeven.basis: Imperial's average yearly amount over the last three years before the launch
